source_excerpt:
After twin teenage sisters are abducted – one body recovered from the Mississippi River, the other nowhere to be found – veteran criminologist Alan Kramer (Devon Sawa) is drawn into a town suffocating under suspicion and fear. Working under relentless Police Captain Erica Graysmith (Tiffany Haddish), and forced to partner with Amelia Pembrock (Maggie Grace), a brilliant but untested profiler, Kramer quickly discovers this is no ordinary abduction. What begins as a local manhunt erupts into a media firestorm as chilling clues reveal a meticulous killer who plans every move with surgical precision and may be hiding in plain sight. Kramer and Pembrock must crawl inside the mind of a predator in a relentless race against time before another child is lost forever.
